summary: Inno Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that Nasdaq imposed a Trading Halt (Code T12) on its common stock post-market on June 8, 2026. In response, the board formed a special committee of independent directors to investigate unusual trading activities. The company states it is unaware of any material undisclosed corporate developments. This filing does not involve a transaction or a forced management change; it is an internal review of trading anomalies. There are no deal terms. Watch for findings of the investigation or potential regulatory actions.
